description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by researcher location over time. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Year," ordered chronologically from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "Number of datasets," and utilizes a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^0$ to $10^2$, with major tick marks at intervals of powers of ten ($10^0$, $10^1$, $10^2$). The chart features grouped bars, where each year contains a cluster of side-by-side bars representing different researcher locations. A legend titled "Researcher Location" identifies the color-coded categories: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). The number of datasets varies across the years, with the tallest bar appearing in the "Other" category in 2021, reaching an approximate value of 120. The shortest bars correspond to a value of 1 ($10^0$), which occurs in several instances, including USA in 2014, DE in 2015, IN in 2017, and IT in 2022. The groups are sorted chronologically along the horizontal axis, and within each year's cluster, the bars are arranged in the order listed in the legend. Notably, the bars for the year 2022 are visually distinguished through a faded, lower-opacity shading compared to the solid colors used for the years 2012 through 2021.
